fields.description: Lets anyone with an asset's QR link submit a work request without signing in. Submissions are rate limited.
fields.label: Allow Public Requests from Asset QR Codes
Create PM Work Orders (Days Before Due)
Installation Procedure
fields.description: Attached to the installation job created for each delivered machine.

fields.label: Default Parts Warehouse
fields.description: Offered first when technicians record parts. They can pick another warehouse, such as their van.

fields.label: Parts Expense Account
fields.description: Default expense account on Material Requests raised for job parts. Leave blank to use the company's.

fields.label: Labour Item (per hour)
fields.description: Service item invoiced for hourly labour. Its Standard Selling price is the default hourly rate.

fields.label: Labour Item (flat fee)
fields.description: Service item invoiced for flat-fee jobs, such as a call-out. Its Standard Selling price is the default fee.

fields.label: Labour Cost per Hour
fields.description: What an hour of technician time costs you (wages and overheads). Reports use it to work out the profit on each service contract.

fields.label: Email the Service Report when a Customer Job is Completed
fields.description: Sends the PDF report to the customer's email address on file as soon as the job is completed. Leave off to send reports by hand from the job.

fields.label: Service Report Footer
fields.description: Printed at the bottom of every report, for example warranty terms or a thank-you note.
